To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
pressure-induced lattice distortion can be used to modify the upconversion quantum efficiency of lanthanide-based nanoparticles.
pressure-induced lattice distortion can be used to systematically modify both the optical selection rules and spatial separations of lanthanide ions in upconverting nanoparticles.

(i) pressure-induced lattice distortion in hexagonal-phase NaYF4 nanoparticles leads to a monotonic decrease of upconversion emission, and (ii) pressure-induced lattice distortions in cubic-phase NaYF 4 nanoparticles lead to a nearly two-fold increase in upconversion efficiency.
